title: TerraNostra-Bench: Benchmarking Spatial Downscaling and Temporal Rollout for Global 1-km Land-Use Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.27793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Uncertainty in the terrestrial carbon cycle remains a major constraint in climate projections, partly due to imperfect land surface representations in Earth system models. We propose a data-driven framework for high-resolution land-use reconstruction, treated as a semantic-segmentation task, that combines coarse-resolution scenario data and climate classification with static geophysical features to produce annual land-use maps at 1 km resolution. We introduce TerraNostra-Bench, a change-aware evaluation protocol that separates spatial downscaling from autoregressive temporal rollout and scores models on the rare land-use-change pixels rather than the dominant static background. Using it, we compare convolutional (U-Net) and transformer (Swin) backbones in autoregressive and non-autoregressive schemes against persistence, linear, and shallow convolutional baselines. translated_title: TerraNostra-Bench：面向全球1公里分辨率土地利用重建的空间降尺度与时间滚动预测基准
translated_abstract: 陆地碳循环的不确定性仍然是气候预测中的主要制约因素，部分原因在于地球系统模型对陆地表面的刻画不够完善。我们提出了一种数据驱动的高分辨率土地利用重建框架，将其视为语义分割任务，该框架结合粗分辨率情景数据、气候分类与静态地球物理特征，生成1公里分辨率的年度土地利用地图。我们提出了TerraNostra-Bench，这是一种变化感知的评估协议，它将空间降尺度与自回归时间滚动预测分离开来，并在稀少的土地利用变化像素而非占主导地位的静态背景上对模型进行评分。利用该基准，我们比较了卷积（U-Net）和Transformer（Swin）骨干网络在自回归与非自回归方案下的表现，并与持续性、线性以及浅层卷积基线进行了对比。自回归先验是信息量最大的输入，但会累积……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了TerraNostra-Bench，这是一个变化感知的评估基准，将空间降尺度与自回归时间滚动预测解耦，并聚焦于稀少的土地利用变化像素进行评分，从而推动数据驱动方法生成全球1公里分辨率的年度土地利用地图。
en_tdlr: TerraNostra-Bench is a change-aware benchmark that decouples spatial downscaling from autoregressive temporal rollout and scores models on rare land-use-change pixels, advancing data-driven reconstruction of global 1-km annual land-use maps.
